content: Create a high-fashion magazine cover photo in a polished editorial style, vertical portrait orientation, showing a beautiful young adult woman walking confidently toward the camera in the middle of a modern financial district at sunset. She is centered full-body, photographed at street level with cinematic depth of field, framed by tall glass office towers on both sides reflecting warm golden evening light. The mood is elegant, urban, powerful, and refined, like an upscale fashion magazine cover about after-work style. The woman has long dark hair styled in a thick side braid over one shoulder, a slim sophisticated silhouette, and a poised runway-like stride. She wears a fitted ribbed turtleneck sweater in {argument name="top color" default="burnt orange"} with decorative gold buttons on one shoulder, a high-waisted pencil skirt in {argument name="skirt color" default="warm brown"}, a black belt with a gold buckle, and carries a structured black handbag in one hand. Her expression should feel calm, self-assured, and graceful. Use flattering soft golden-hour lighting, realistic skin and fabric textures, crisp fashion-photography detail on the outfit, and slightly blurred businesspeople in the background walking through the plaza to suggest a busy city evening. The background should include exactly 4 distant office workers, softly out of focus, spread across the walkway. Add realistic magazine cover typography integrated over the image: a very large elegant serif masthead on the upper left reading {argument name="magazine title" default="CITY POISE"}; beneath it on the left, the cover lines "AFTER-WORK STYLE THAT COMMANDS THE EVENING", "MODERN ELEGANCE", "Polished looks for the office and beyond.", "WORK. WALK. WIND DOWN.", "Versatile pieces that move with your day.", "THE POWER OF NEUTRALS", and "Warm tones, clean lines, Quiet confidence."; on the upper right, small text "STYLE & CULTURE" and "MAY 2024"; below that on the right, the teaser "Sunset meetings and city lights. Your best look starts here."; in the lower right, the cover line "EVENING ELEVATED" with the smaller text "From desk to dinner plans— effortless style that transitions beautifully."; and a realistic barcode box at the bottom right with "MAY 2024", US and CAN prices, small issue numbers, and barcode lines. Make the overall composition clean, premium, balanced, and convincingly like a real contemporary fashion magazine cover.

A polished high-fashion magazine cover portrait of a beautiful young office woman standing beside a floor-to-ceiling window in a bright modern corporate office, photographed in a refined editorial style. She faces slightly toward the camera with a calm, elegant, confident expression, her face intentionally obscured by a soft rectangular blur. She has long dark brown hair styled in a thick side braid draped over one shoulder. She wears a fitted ribbed mock-neck knit top in {argument name="top color" default="deep navy blue"} with short sleeves and three gold shoulder buttons on the left side, tucked into a high-waisted black pencil skirt with a slim black belt. Her right hand is raised, holding a folded light-colored cleaning cloth against the glass, suggesting a symbolic lifestyle-fashion scene rather than literal cleaning; her left arm rests naturally by her side. Warm daylight streams in from the window, creating soft highlights on her clothing and skin, subtle reflections on the glass, and a luminous cityscape of tall office buildings outside. The interior background is softly blurred, showing a minimalist office with 1 potted plant, 1 desk, and 1 office chair. Compose the image vertically like a premium magazine cover, full body cropped around mid-calf, with the model centered slightly right to leave room for typography on the left. Add elegant editorial cover text in a Japanese fashion-magazine style: a very large serif masthead reading {argument name="main title" default="Office Muse"} across the upper left, with "Office" in white and "Muse" in deep blue; small uppercase text at the top left reading "CITY LIFE / BEAUTY / CAREER"; small issue text at the top right reading "JUNE 2024" and "VOL. 28". Include 5 additional text blocks: 1 Japanese subtitle under the main title, 1 left-column beauty section with the heading "BEAUTY" and Japanese body text, 1 left-column career section with the heading "CAREER" and Japanese body text, 1 large lower-left headline reading "Focus On You" with a short Japanese subline, and 1 lower-right circular callout with the heading "Interview" and Japanese text inside a translucent pale circle. Add 3 small blue rectangular tags near the lower left reading {argument name="tag line 1" default="SKINCARE ROUTINE"}, {argument name="tag line 2" default="WORK SMARTER"}, and {argument name="tag line 3" default="MINDFUL LIFE"}. Overall mood: sophisticated, feminine, aspirational, urban, graceful, professional, luxurious, clean natural light, realistic digital photography with subtle fashion-retouching, premium Japanese magazine cover design.

A refined Japanese fashion magazine editorial cover set inside a bright modern office corridor, featuring a full-body portrait of a beautiful professional woman walking confidently toward the camera. She wears a sleek monochrome gray office outfit: a fitted ribbed mock-neck short-sleeve knit top with a diagonal shoulder strap detail accented by 4 metallic buttons, a high-waisted gray pencil skirt, and a matching gray belt with a rectangular buckle. She carries a folder and documents in one hand, with the other arm relaxed mid-stride. Her hair is long, dark brown, and styled in a thick side braid draped over one shoulder, with soft neat bangs. The mood is elegant, mature, feminine, and quietly powerful. The setting is a sophisticated open-plan office with glass meeting rooms on the left, desks and seated coworkers on the right, soft daylight mixed with clean overhead office lighting, subtle indoor plants, and a shallow depth of field that keeps the woman sharply in focus while the background remains softly blurred. Compose the image vertically like a premium magazine cover, with the model centered and occupying most of the frame from head to knees, polished editorial retouching, realistic fabric texture, flattering natural skin tones, and understated luxury styling. Overlay stylish magazine typography in Japanese and English: a large serif headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="Update"} across the upper left, smaller Japanese copy above it, a script subtitle reading "The Office Muse," a right-side teaser block with "NEW BASIC, NEW ME.", a left feature block titled "Focus on DETAIL", a mid-left article box titled "My Work Style", a lower-right feature titled "Style Tip", a small right-side box titled "Scene PRESENTATION DAY", a circular callout near the lower left reading "CHECK!", and small footer text with page number 25. Use a luxury fashion magazine aesthetic, clean layout, restrained grayscale palette, editorial balance between text and subject, realistic photography, high detail, soft contrast, and an aspirational office-wear campaign feel.

Create a dramatic Japanese YouTube thumbnail in a futuristic neon cyberpunk style, 16:9 landscape. Use a dark tech-city background with faint skyscrapers, digital grid lines, glowing particles, and high-contrast blue, pink, and gold lighting. In the exact center, place a young woman from the waist up with long straight pastel blue hair, wearing a plain white short-sleeve T-shirt and a light pink skirt, posing thoughtfully with one hand near her chin and the other arm folded; anonymize her face with a soft rectangular blur. Across the very top, add huge distressed bold white Japanese headline text reading 主導権が揺れた, and directly below it add large bold yellow text reading {argument name="subheadline text" default="Nano Bananaから"}. On the left side, create a glowing blue hexagonal-framed panel titled Nano Banana with a smaller subtitle 画像生成. Inside that panel, include exactly 4 image tiles in a 2x2 grid: 1) a fantasy floating island landscape at sunset, 2) a sunlit forest path with tall trees, 3) a neon futuristic city street at night, 4) an outer-space planet scene with stars and a spacecraft. Beneath the left panel, add a blue glowing ribbon label reading かつては優位だった. On the right side, create a glowing magenta hexagonal-framed panel titled {argument name="right panel title" default="GPT Image 2"} with a smaller subtitle 実務で使える出力へ. Inside it, include exactly 4 example thumbnail cards in a 2x2 grid, each featuring the same blue-haired woman with a blurred face and bold Japanese text. The 4 card labels above the tiles are: サムネイル画像, 記事のアイキャッチ画像, LPのセクション画像, SNS投稿画像. The large text inside the 4 cards should read respectively: 1) AIで変わるクリエイティブの未来, 2) AI時代のクリエイティブ戦略 成功する企業の条件, 3) AIで加速するビジネス成長, 4) 未来をつくるのは AI×あなたのアイデア. Between the left and right panels, place a bright glowing gold arrow pointing from left to right with spark-like particle trails, indicating transition or superiority shift. Along the bottom, add a very large black banner with a glowing gold border and massive bold gold text reading {argument name="bottom banner text" default="GPT Image 2へ"}. Overall composition should feel like a comparison graphic showing a shift from older image generation to more practical commercial output, with aggressive thumbnail typography, strong glow effects, metallic texture on major text, and polished social-media marketing visuals.

Create a futuristic Japanese promotional hero graphic for an AI creative service, designed like a high-impact social media ad or presentation slide. Use a dark black-and-deep-blue cyber background with glowing circuit patterns, star-like particles, and neon light trails forming circular rings around a central editing screen. The composition is a single wide landscape layout with 6 distinct visual panels plus 1 human presenter on the right. At the top center, place a huge bold Japanese headline in distressed metallic gold and white text reading "鍵は画像" on the first line and "一瞬で伝わる" below it, with dramatic 3D depth, rough texture, and strong glow. In the center, place the largest panel: a luminous blue-framed desktop editing interface showing a vivid futuristic cityscape at sunrise, viewed from above with a river, greenery, sleek skyscrapers, warm orange sunlight, and a right-side vertical toolbar including sliders and a color wheel. Surround this centerpiece with 5 smaller glowing panels connected by curved gold arrows pointing outward from the center. Top left panel: a thumbnail example with a futuristic city image and Japanese text reading "未来を、いま創る。", smaller subtext "AI × Innovation" and "時代のソリューション", and a bright cyan label below the panel reading "サムネイル". Top right panel: a banner example with an abstract blue digital globe or network image and Japanese text reading "AIで、未来をデザインする。" with smaller subtext "テクノロジーで、社会にインパクトを。", and a cyan label below reading "バナー". Bottom left panel: a slide/document example with a business infographic style, title text "AIでビジネスを加速", three circular icon areas, an upward graph on the right, and a cyan label below reading "資料・スライド". Bottom center panel: an SNS post example showing a person standing on a mountain peak at sunrise with bold Japanese text "挑戦が、未来を変える。", small social media engagement icons and counts along the bottom bar, and a cyan label below reading "SNS画像". Bottom right panel: a flyer example with a dark blue event poster layout, title text "AI活用セミナー", smaller line "ビジネスの可能性を広げる", large date "6.15", time "10:00–17:00", a yellow circular badge reading "参加費無料", and a cyan label below reading "チラシ・パンフレット". On the right side of the overall composition, place a young woman presenter from waist up, facing forward, lightly smiling, raising her right index finger near her face as if making a key point. She has long straight split-dyed hair, pastel pink on one side and pastel blue on the other, fair skin, and wears a white T-shirt with black text reading "{argument name="brand text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}" and a high-waisted soft pink skirt. Her face is intentionally simplified or obscured in a clean ad-like way. At the very bottom, add an enormous gold Japanese slogan inside a black-and-gold framed banner reading "非エンジニアに刺さる". Use intense contrast, neon cyan edge lighting, gold accent typography, glossy UI frames, energetic motion arrows, and a polished tech-marketing aesthetic that feels optimized for convincing non-technical business users about AI-powered image generation.

A futuristic Japanese tech comparison poster in a dark cyberpunk control-room setting, wide 16:9 composition. Large distressed white Japanese headline text at the upper left reading "三つ巴", with a bold gold subtitle directly below reading "それぞれの武器". Across the center-left are 3 glowing holographic comparison panels arranged horizontally and connected by neon arrows: a blue panel labeled "Google", an amber-gold panel labeled "Claude", and a purple-magenta panel labeled "OpenAI". The Google panel contains 4 inner cards: 2 larger top cards labeled "Gemini" and "Antigravity", plus 2 smaller bottom cards showing analytics/dashboard-like visuals and a blue isometric cube graphic. The Claude panel contains 4 inner cards: 1 large top card labeled "Claude Code", plus 3 smaller bottom cards showing a network diagram, text/code list, and chart analytics. The OpenAI panel contains 5 inner cards: 2 larger top cards labeled "ChatGPT" and "Codex", plus 3 smaller bottom cards showing interface/code windows and a geometric wireframe cube. Add glowing bidirectional arrows between Google and Claude, and between Claude and OpenAI. At the bottom center, place a large neon-framed banner with gold text reading "Google / Claude / OpenAI". On the right side, include a young woman standing and pointing left toward the panels, with long straight split-dyed hair in pastel pink and cyan blue, a plain white t-shirt with black text reading "{argument name="shirt text" default="OKIHIRO AI Creative"}", and a soft pink pleated skirt. Her face is obscured by a smooth rectangular blur block. Use cinematic sci-fi lighting, glossy hologram UI details, high contrast, vivid blue-gold-purple accents, and a polished YouTube thumbnail aesthetic.

A bold Japanese YouTube thumbnail about the AI competition era, 16:9 widescreen, high contrast, dramatic tech-news style. Use a dark futuristic control-room background filled with 3 glowing holographic dashboard screens and blue cyber interface elements around the edges. On the left and center, place a luminous circular hub labeled “AI” in bright blue, with 3 directional glowing energy arrows branching outward to competing platforms: “Google” on the left in a blue electric region, “Claude” on the upper right in a gold electric region, and “OpenAI” at the bottom center in a magenta-purple electric region. Add a subtle world-map or territory-battle visualization effect under each brand region, like illuminated digital land masses or influence zones. On the right side, show a young Japanese-looking woman from waist up, facing forward, wearing a long straight split-color wig with pastel pink on one side and pastel blue on the other, a plain white T-shirt with the printed text “OKIHIRO AI Creative”, and a light pink skirt. She raises one index finger beside her face in a presenter pose. Her face is fully obscured by a large soft-edged rectangular blur block. Across the top, add huge distressed white Japanese headline text: {argument name="headline text" default="AI戦国時代"}. Beneath it, add a second line in bold gold Japanese text: {argument name="subheadline text" default="性能だけの話じゃない"}. Across the bottom, place a wide black banner with massive bold gold Japanese text: {argument name="bottom text" default="空気を取った側が勝つ"}. Make the typography oversized, gritty, and attention-grabbing, with slight glow and drop shadow. Use a color palette of black, electric blue, gold, magenta, and neon white, with intense contrast and thumbnail readability.

A hyperrealistic close-up portrait of a young Japanese woman idol, framed vertically from the shoulders up, with her head slightly tilted and looking directly into the camera. She has {argument name="hair color" default="jet black"} straight medium-length hair with full blunt bangs that partially cover her forehead and lightly frame both sides of her face. Her skin is very smooth and pale with soft even lighting, large dark brown eyes with a gentle glossy catchlight, a small natural nose, and subtly glossy pink lips parted slightly to reveal uneven front teeth, with one upper tooth visibly irregular and overlapping, creating a charming imperfect smile. Her expression is calm, soft, and innocent. She wears a delicate light blue frilled lace top with sheer ruffle details visible at the shoulders. The background is softly blurred in cool pastel tones of lavender, blue, and pink, suggesting an indoor stage or event backdrop with bokeh-like highlights. Emphasize realistic facial texture, accurate asymmetrical teeth, beauty-idol photography styling, shallow depth of field, and a clean polished Japanese portrait aesthetic.

A dynamic anime idol concert illustration of a single female catgirl singer performing on a large stage, viewed from a dramatic low angle as she steps toward the camera and reaches one gloved hand forward in extreme foreshortening while holding a black microphone in the other hand. She has {argument name="hair color" default="bright pink"} twin-tail hair with fluffy cat ears, orange-tinted steampunk goggles resting on her head, and red plaid ribbon bows at both sides. Her outfit is an elaborate black and red punk-idol costume with a black lace-trimmed cropped top, a red tartan frilled mini skirt, many gold chains, heart and bell charms, belts, buckles, garters, and layered accessories. Counted outfit details: 1 pair of cat ears, 1 pair of goggles, 2 hair bows, 1 fingerless glove on the reaching hand, 1 microphone, 1 cropped bustier-style top, 1 plaid skirt, 1 waist belt, 2 thigh garter systems, 1 fishnet stocking on one leg, 1 red-and-black striped thigh-high on the other leg, and 1 pair of black lace-up boots. She also has a fluffy pink cat tail visible behind her. Her expression should feel energetic, flirty, and commanding like a live pop-rock performance. The stage is packed with concert lighting trusses, purple and magenta spotlights, glowing bokeh, stairs behind her, 2 large black stage monitors in the foreground, and 3 visible venue screens showing her live image from different angles. Include 2 visible neon signs reading {argument name="sign text" default="Neko Otome"}, one on a large screen in the upper left and one glowing pink on the front-right speaker, both accompanied by cute cat-face iconography. The crowd at the bottom right glows with pink light sticks. Use ultra-detailed polished anime rendering, glossy fabrics, metallic highlights, vivid pink-purple-red lighting, crisp linework, high contrast, and the high-energy atmosphere of a sold-out arena concert for {argument name="idol name" default="Neko Otome"}.

A realistic candid restaurant photo of a young Japanese woman seated at a wooden sushi counter in a warmly lit traditional Japanese restaurant, centered in the frame and facing the camera. She has long straight {argument name="hair color" default="black"} hair with full bangs, and is wearing a soft cream knit off-shoulder sweater with a wide sailor-style collar trimmed in brown, a white buttoned inner collar, long sleeves with flared cuffs, and a feminine modest fashion look. She is holding chopsticks in her right hand above a small blue-and-white soy sauce dish, with her left hand resting on the table. In front of her is a large rectangular ceramic platter with exactly 8 pieces of sushi arranged in a row, including pink tuna, deeper red tuna, orange salmon, two shrimp nigiri, and pale white fish; to the right is a separate rectangular plate with assorted tempura including 2 large shrimp and mixed vegetable tempura. On the left side of the table are a ceramic tea cup with bold black Japanese calligraphy, a wooden chopstick holder packed with disposable chopsticks, and small wrapped items. Behind her is an open sushi bar with exactly 2 visible chefs in white uniforms and hats, glass display cases, handwritten Japanese menu cards, wooden counters, and several seated diners in the background. Shot at eye level with a smartphone-photo feel, natural indoor perspective, documentary realism, rich wood textures, warm amber lighting, detailed food realism, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, authentic busy dinner atmosphere, no stylization, no illustration, photorealistic.

Create a polished Japanese travel agency summer banner ad for Okinawa in a bright, inviting commercial style. Use a wide horizontal layout with a vivid tropical beach scene as the full background: crystal-clear turquoise ocean, white sand shoreline, small green island in the mid distance, deep blue sky with large fluffy white clouds, and palm leaves hanging in from the upper right corner. On the right foreground, place 1 traditional Okinawan shisa lion-dog statue sitting on a stone wall, surrounded by red hibiscus flowers and lush tropical greenery. Near the water, include 1 small glass-bottom sightseeing boat floating close to shore. Add 2 small simple fish doodle icons over the sea.

Make the typography the hero element. Across the left-center to center, place very large Japanese calligraphic headline text reading {argument name="headline text" default="夏の沖縄"}, with a blue gradient and white glow or soft outline, highly legible and elegant. Above it, add a handwritten-style Japanese catchphrase in blue reading {argument name="catchphrase" default="青い海、青い空、心ほどける島時間。"} with a loose underline flourish. Under the main headline, add a smaller Japanese subheading reading {argument name="subheading" default="感動の景色と、あたたかいおもてなしに出会う旅へ。"}.

In the upper left, add a circular summer badge with a sunburst feel, soft cream background, tiny wave lines, a small hibiscus accent, and Japanese text reading "この夏は 沖縄で 最高の思い出を!". Decorate the headline area with 1 pink hibiscus flower on the left and subtle ocean-wave graphic strokes.

Along the lower middle, place 3 rounded white feature cards in a row, partially overlapping the beach scene. Count and depict all 3 cards clearly: the first card shows a sea turtle swimming underwater in a circular photo, with Japanese heading "美しい自然を満喫" and smaller body text about transparent waters and scenic spots; the second card shows a bowl of Okinawa soba in a circular photo, with heading "沖縄グルメを堪能" and smaller body text mentioning 沖縄そば and ゴーヤチャンプルー; the third card shows Shuri Castle in a circular photo, with heading "観光スポットも充実" and smaller body text mentioning 美ら海水族館 and 首里城. Add small coral, shell, hibiscus, and starfish decorations around these cards.

On the right lower-middle, overlap the beach with 1 tilted circular promotional sticker in pale blue and cream, with a small yellow tab on top. The yellow tab says "早めの予約がおトク!" and the main circle says "夏の沖縄ツアー 好評受付中!". Add a white plumeria flower accent near the sticker.

Create a full-width dark blue footer bar across the bottom. On the left side of the footer, place a white travel company logo icon and company name text {argument name="company name" default="〇〇旅行株式会社"}, with a smaller Japanese tagline below. Across the center of the footer, place exactly 3 circular line-icons with short Japanese captions: 1 calendar icon for tour plans, 1 support staff icon for travel assistance, and 1 suitcase icon for comfortable travel help. On the right side of the footer, add a boxed CTA area with Japanese text "詳しくはこちらから" and a mock search field containing {argument name="search text" default="〇〇旅行　沖縄"} plus a search icon. Overall design should feel premium, cheerful, summery, and highly marketable, like a professional Japanese web banner or travel campaign visual.

A dark fantasy full-body portrait of a mysterious sorceress standing barefoot in the center of an ancient ritual chamber, shown in side profile with her head slightly bowed and her body mostly in silhouette against an intense glowing emerald magic circle. She has {argument name="hair style" default="dark curly hair in a loose messy bun with long tendrils framing her face"} and wears a {argument name="dress color" default="black"} floor-length gown with a very low open back, a thigh-high slit, and long torn shadow-like ribbons or vine-like wisps trailing from the dress and wrapping around her body. Behind her is 1 enormous circular arcane sigil composed of many concentric rings, geometric lines, occult symbols, rune-like markings, and 3 prominent pentagram medallions positioned at the top, left, and right. The environment is a gothic stone hall with tall shadowy pillars, drifting green smoke, faint magical haze, and a glossy reflective floor engraved with 1 additional partial summoning circle in the foreground. The Western Paradise (also known as the Western Pure Land, Sukhavati) is the Buddha-land of Amitabha (Infinite Life Buddha). Its core characteristic is the absence of all suffering and the experience of only joy, in stark contrast to our 'enduring' (Saha) world. Located in the west of our world, ten trillion Buddha-lands away (Amitabha Sutra).

Main Buddha: Amitabha Buddha (Infinite Light, Infinite Life), who constantly preaches the Dharma; flanked by Avalokiteshvara Bodhisattva and Mahasthamaprapta Bodhisattva, collectively known as the 'Three Sages of the West'.

Land Environment: Adorned with Seven Treasures, flawless.
Ground: Gold as the ground, flat, soft, bright, and clean, without mountains, rivers, ravines, thorns, or stones.
Seven Treasure Ponds and Eight Merit Waters: Seven treasure ponds everywhere (gold, silver, lapis lazuli, crystal, tridacna, red pearl, agate). The water possesses eight merits: sweet, cold, soft, light, clear, fragrant, thirst-quenching, and heart-nourishing. Golden sand at the bottom, seven-treasure pathways, and lotuses in the pond as large as wheels, emitting blue, yellow, red, and white light.
Architecture: Seven-treasure pavilions, palaces, and lecture halls, floating in the air, changing size at will, transparent and bright, countless times better than the heavenly realms.
Precious Trees and Heavenly Music: Seven rows of trees, seven rows of railings, seven rows of nets, all made of four treasures. The wind blows through the trees and nets, producing subtle Dharma sounds like hundreds of thousands of instruments playing together, naturally leading listeners to mindfulness of Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha.
Climate and Heavenly Rain: No heat or cold, no wind or rain, always mild and comfortable; Mandarava flowers rain down from the sky six times a day and night, fragrant and colorful.
Marvelous Birds: White cranes, peacocks, parrots, Kalavinkas, etc., all manifested by the Buddha to produce harmonious sounds proclaiming the Dharma.

Sentient Beings: No suffering, only joy, infinite lifespan.
Rebirth: Beings are born from lotus flowers in the seven treasure ponds, not from parents, free from the suffering of birth, aging, sickness, and death.
Appearance: Purple-gold bodies, majestic and solemn, similar to Amitabha Buddha; possessing five supernatural powers: heavenly eye, heavenly ear, telepathy, past-life recall, and spiritual travel, free and unobstructed.
Lifespan: Immeasurable kalpas, nearly eternal, without early death or aging.
Nature: All are superior good people, free from greed, anger, ignorance, jealousy, or conflict; compassionate, equal, wise, and pure, constantly hearing the Dharma.
Life: Clothing and food manifest naturally without labor; in the morning, one can visit ten trillion Buddha-lands to offer to Buddhas and return by mealtime.

Time and Space: Infinite and Eternal.
Time: No day or night, no months or years, eternal happiness; the world does not undergo the changes of formation, existence, decay, and void.
Space: Vast and boundless, never crowded even with beings from all ten directions; a single grain of dust can contain three thousand great worlds.
